invite.title: 360° capture invitation
invite.intro: {host} invites you to upload 360° panoramas for the property {property}.
invite.scope: Accepting only lets you upload to this property, for a limited time — you do not join any office.
invite.identityDeclared: The sender's details are declared, not verified.
invite.signInHint: Use the account with the email address that received this invitation — or create one.
invite.acceptedBody: You can now upload captures for this property.
invite.declinedBody: The sender will see that you declined.
invite.unavailable: We could not complete this right now.

inviteRefusal.linkForeign: This link was issued by a different environment. Ask for a new one.

refusal.captureNotReady: The panorama is still being prepared. You can place it shortly.
refusal.nodeAbsent: The point no longer exists. Refresh the page.
refusal.levelAbsent: This floor does not belong to this tour.
refusal.roomInvalid: Choose up to three room types and a name of up to 60 characters.

refusal.spaceInvalid: The room outline is not valid: its sides must not cross and the room must have an area.
refusal.spaceOutsidePlan: All corners of the room must be on the floor plan.

refusal.graphFull: The tour has reached its point limit.

panel.title: 360° tour
panel.description: Invite a photographer or upload panoramas. Panoramas land in the inbox and are placed on the floor plan later.
panel.inviteReasonPlaceholder: e.g. capture before the walls are closed
panel.noCaptures: No panorama has been uploaded yet.
panel.loadFailed: The tour details could not be loaded.

delivery.accepted: The invitation was handed to the email provider.
delivery.unaddressable: The invitation was created, but no email was sent (the public address is missing).
delivery.failed: The invitation was created, but the email was not sent. Try resending.

upload.creator: Creator
upload.paused: Network interrupted — the upload will continue where it left off.
upload.done: The panorama was uploaded to the inbox.
upload.replayed: This panorama had already been uploaded.

myCaptures.title: My captures

myCaptures.empty: You have no capture permission for any property.

visibilityHint.public: Anyone who sees the listing sees the tour too.

viewing.spaceAreas: Room areas on the public page

access.cardPublic: Walk through the property in 360°, room by room.
access.cardOnRequest: The listing manager shows the tour on request.
access.messagePlaceholder: e.g. I am interested in buying — when can we talk?
access.pending: Your request was sent — you will be notified when it is answered.
access.signInHint: Access is bound to your account — so the manager knows who is viewing the home.

viewer.title: 360° tour
viewer.preparing: The tour is being prepared — the panoramas are being processed for viewing. Try again shortly.
viewer.unavailable: The tour is not available right now.
viewer.signedInAs: You are signed in as {email}. If access was granted to another of your accounts, switch account.
viewer.panorama: 360° panorama — drag to look around; arrow keys to turn, + and − to zoom.
viewer.loadFailed: The panorama did not load. Try another point or again shortly.

editor.description: Put each panorama on a floor and a point, and use arrows to show where the next room is.
editor.title: Place panoramas
editor.noPoints: There is no point yet. Choose a panorama from the inbox.
editor.missingArrows: {count, plural, one {# arrow missing} other {# arrows missing}}
editor.selectPrompt: Choose a panorama or a point from the list.
editor.notReadyHint: The panorama is being processed. You can view and place it shortly.
editor.failedHint: The panorama could not be processed. Upload it again.
editor.modeNextTo: New point, next to an existing one
editor.modeSameAs: Same point as an existing one (newer capture)
editor.removeLast: This is the only panorama of point {number}. The point and its arrows will be deleted; the panorama returns to the inbox.
editor.removeOne: The panorama returns to the inbox. Point {number} keeps its other panoramas.
editor.removed: The panorama returned to the inbox.
editor.arrowsHint: Drag a point onto the photo, where the doorway to it is. Or turn the view so the circle in the centre points at the doorway and press “Arrow here”.
editor.arrowHereFor: Arrow to “{name}” at the centre of the view
editor.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Please try again.
editor.roomLabelHint: E.g. “Engineer’s office”. If left empty, the type is shown — translated for foreign visitors.
editor.roomSaved: The room of this point was saved.
editor.planHint: Choose this floor's plan from the property's files.

editor.planLoadFailed: The floor plans could not be loaded.
editor.planChangeWarning: With a new floor plan the positions of this floor's points are cleared — you will place them again on it.
editor.planScaleMissing: Set the scale: mark both ends of a known dimension (e.g. a 4.20 m wall).

editor.planRemovePoint: Remove the point from the floor plan

editor.planDirectionHint: Turn the cone so it points to the centre of the photo.
